reviews.body: Thanks for the fix! I checked that a missing `index` now falls back to the existing index-0 remap path, that a name-bearing delta without an index starts a new call while argument-only deltas continue the latest one, and that indexed deltas behave as before. The new tests cover all three cases, and CI passes on Python 3.11–3.13. The only thing left is the CLA check: could you sign it by posting the comment the CLA bot asked for above? I'll merge as soon as it goes green.
